name: audiogen-cpp
description: ACE-Step text-to-music engine in pure C++/ggml, from qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's engines/audiogen. Same pin as port-version 0 (master HEAD 26803b09, QVAC-22955: sequential lazy stage loading — create() loads each stage right before its step and frees it right after, bounding the peak resident set to a single stage so a non-entitled iOS app is no longer jetsam-killed mid-load). This republish raises the ggml-speech floor to 2026-07-30, a hard dependency rather than a courtesy bump: the ACE-Step FSQ detokenizer casts a Q4_K special-tokens tensor to F32 in-graph and runs on the GPU only under Vulkan, so before qvac-ext-ggml PR #47 every Vulkan runner aborted on 'Missing CPY op for types: q4_K f32', with no CPU fallback to absorb it. Carries the Vulkan snake / col2im_1d kernels and GGML_PREC_F32 matmul paths from PRs #45 / #46.
